title: About
description: About Will Qing, an Information Engineering undergraduate at Shanghai Jiao Tong University.
heading: A person before a profile.

paragraphs: I’m Will. I’m currently a student, and most of my work lives somewhere around AI, scientific computing, physical systems, and whatever new problem I become curious enough to investigate.

I like research, but I don’t want this website to pretend that research is the whole person. I also care a lot about music, books, films, storytelling, and the small pieces of culture that end up becoming part of how we understand ourselves.
I made this site partly because I wanted one place that could hold all of those things without forcing them into the shape of a résumé.
